description: Defines data structures related to NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) configuration, assistance information, and management within the ocudu::ocudu_ntn namespace.

classes.name: ntn_assistance_info
classes.description: Contains fields for NTN assistance data such as ephemeris, timing, and coverage info.

classes.name: ntn_cell_config
classes.description: Holds configuration details for an NTN cell, including assistance info.

classes.name: ntn_configuration_manager_config
classes.description: Aggregates multiple NTN cell configurations for management purposes.
